Players Committee card image of [[Rebel Leadership (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Take an admiral or general into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your admiral is in battle at a system (or your general is in battle at a site), you may either add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny.”
